description: This file defines FastAPI route handlers for CRUD operations on 'Trip' objects within a travel planning application. It includes endpoints to list, retrieve, create, update, and delete trips, and handles sharing permissions. The functions convert ORM trip objects to response schemas, verify user access rights, and manage trip data interactions with the database.

methods.name: TripResponse _trip_to_response(trip: Trip)
methods.description: Converts a Trip ORM object into a TripResponse schema object for API responses.

methods.name: Trip _get_trip_with_access(trip_id: str, user: User, db: Session, require_edit: bool = False)
methods.description: Fetches a trip by ID and verifies the current user's access rights, raising appropriate exceptions if access is denied.
